body.message:
As per the latest update received from the owner, we need to arrange our maintenance team to carry out the necessary repairs to the ceiling in the apartment.

May I kindly know if it would be convenient for you to allow our team to attend tomorrow if possible what time you can allow the team? and If tomorrow is not suitable, please share a convenient date and time that works for you, and we will arrange the team accordingly.

We appreciate your cooperation and apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
